title: Shared shapes
description: Pieces the other schemas share: an effect reference, an item and quantity line, a production output, the plan block, the simulator's intent, and a Rules statement. Word lists (enums) are copies of the game's own lists, named in each description; src/tests/CMSSchemas.test.js fails when the game's list and the copy here part ways.

effectRef.description: A reference into the effect library (data/effects.json). Read by effectRefsOf (src/systems/effects/effectLibrary.js); written by the CMS's Rules list (cms/src/components/editors/Statements.jsx). A bare effect id string is accepted too.

scale.description: How strong this bearer's copy is: a whole number 1 to 5 (normaliseScale, MAX_SCALE in src/systems/effects/effectLibrary.js). Stored on the reference, never on the entry.

itemQuantity.description: An item and how many: a cost, an input, an upkeep, a price.

quantity.description: How many; a whole number in practice.

output.description: One production output: an item (itemId), a Token placed on the mat (tokenId), or currency (pays nothing today). Rolled by src/systems/board/BoardRunner.js (chance, then tokenConstants.js outputRange for the quantity); written by the CMS's output rows (cms/src/components/shared/IOEntryList.jsx) and the simulator (cms/src/engine/sim/writeBack.js).

tokenId.description: A Token type placed instead of an item (BoardRunner's tokenId branch).

currency.description: OUTPUT_CURRENCIES (src/config/registries/tokenConstants.js). No game reader pays it out; only the market label (tokenTypeDerivation.js) reads it.

chance.description: Percent 0 to 100, not a fraction. Default 100.

minQty.description: Smallest roll (whole number); derived from baseQty by the simulator.

maxQty.description: Largest roll (whole number). An inverted range is swapped.

quantity.description: Older single quantity, read when minQty and maxQty are absent.

baseQty.description: The author's quantity intent, which the simulator widens into minQty and maxQty (cms/src/engine/sim/fieldAdapter.js). The game reads it only as a fallback for enemy drops (enemyProfile.js).

baseChance.description: Simulator only: the authored chance, seeded by writeBack.js the first time the tuner moves chance (sim/fieldAdapter.js). No game reader.

variable.description: Simulator only (sim/tuningPass.js): the tuner may move this output's quantity. No game reader.

anchor.description: Simulator only (sim/anchorPass.js): this source anchors the item's value. No game reader.

plan.description: The progression ledger's plan block (src/systems/progression/ledger/plan.js). Kept out of data/ by Sync and written to cms/plan/plan.json; the workspace holds it on the record. Written by cms/src/components/shared/PlanFields.jsx. No reader in the running game.

status.description: PLAN_STATUSES in plan.js. A planned record is a stub that never reaches data/.

tier.description: The tier the owner gives it (a whole number).

sim.description: The economic simulator's intent (cms/src/engine/sim/). Written by cms/src/components/shared/SimIntentControls.jsx and XpPin.jsx. No reader in the running game.

purpose.description: SIM_PURPOSES (cms/src/utils/simVocabulary.js): gold, items or XP per hour.

xpPinned.description: The author typed the XP; Recalculate leaves it.

statement.description: One sentence of the Rules grammar (src/systems/effects/statements.js). Its id keys per-copy state (TriggerSystem cooldowns, BlockUpkeep), so it must stay stable. Slots are patched through src/systems/effects/statementSlots.js, which the CMS's Rules editor (Statements.jsx, RulesLine.jsx) imports.

id.description: stm_ followed by letters and digits; unique and stable.

keyword.description: KEYWORD (src/systems/effects/statements.js); what each accepts is its KEYWORDS row. promotes is retired and does nothing.

to.description: Which Tokens it aims at (filterRegistry.js targetModeMatches, from TileModifiers.js). Null or absent means untargeted.

mode.description: TARGET_MODES (src/config/registries/modifierPalette.js): all, tag, id. tokenType is retired but still read. An unknown mode matches nothing.

value.description: The tag, or the Token id, the mode names.

filters.description: Extra conditions, all of which must hold (filterRegistry.js).

kind.description: tagged, is_station, charges_below, carrying or worked.

when.description: The moment it fires (src/config/registries/triggerRegistry.js; read by TriggerSystem.js, LoadoutMoments.js, FightMoments.js, LiveEffects.js). Null or absent means always on.

belowPct.description: Whole percent 1 to 99, default 50; FIGHT_HP_BELOW only.

every.description: Every nth swing or hit (a whole number).

watchItemId.description: The item watched; ITEM_PRODUCED and ITEM_THRESHOLD.

upkeep.description: What keeps it running (src/systems/board/BlockUpkeep.js). Null or absent means free.

cadenceMs.description: Milliseconds between payments (the editor's minimum is 1000).

chargeDelta.description: Charges it changes when it fires; negative spends (chargeMomentRegistry.js chargeDeltaOf). Absent means -1 for a firing rule, 0 for a per-cycle one.

reach.description: REACHES (src/config/registries/reachRegistry.js); adjacent and self_and_adjacent are older names read as nearby and self_and_nearby. Null means nearby.

target.description: Who it acts on, for keywords that act on a role (roleRegistry.js; DealDamage.js, EffectActions.js).

role.description: ROLES (src/config/registries/roleRegistry.js); which ones a keyword takes is its KEYWORDS row.

payload.description: What the statement does; its shape depends on the keyword (blankPayload in src/systems/effects/statements.js). A number effect's type comes from MODIFIER_PALETTE (src/config/registries/modifierPalette.js).

value.description: The modifier's size; a percentage bucket holds a fraction (-0.05 is 5 % less).

category.description: What the modifier is limited to: a skill id or an item id.

skill.description: A skill id (station, and skill-limited rules).

stationKind.description: A STATION_KINDS id narrowing a station's recipe pool.

tag.description: acts_as and requires: the capability tag.

effectId.description: applies: the library effect it lands.

typeId.description: spawns and transforms: a Token type id.
